[B1] < cloudB | 'buffer' : nils , UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'publishToggle' cloudB
=> < cloudB | 'buffer' : 'toggle' , UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'acknowledgeReceipt' UserX .

[B2] < cloudB | UserX : ('permission' : Permission , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'revokePermission' cloudB | UserX
=> < cloudB | UserX : ('permission' : false , ...) , ... > .

[B3] < cloudB | 'buffer' : Message , deviceB : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'releaseBufferedMessage' cloudB
=> < cloudB | 'buffer' : nils , deviceB : ('permission' : true , ...) , ... > $ cloudB 'publishMessage' deviceB | Message if Message =/= nils .

[B3] < deviceB | 'on' : false , ... > $ cloudB 'publishMessage' deviceB | 'toggle'
=> < deviceB | 'on' : true , ... > .
